issues.text: add_members has no existence check before adding a user, so re-adding an existing group member hits the unique index on group_users and raises an unhandled 500 instead of a friendly error, and this is easy to trigger because the frontend never clears the input after submit.
issues.zh: add_members 重複加入既有成員會撞唯一索引直接 500，前端不清空輸入框，使用者按第二次 Add 就會踩到。

issues.text: add_members writes members one at a time in a loop with no transaction, so when one username in a batch fails (e.g. duplicate), earlier usernames in the same batch are already committed, leaving the group in a partially-applied state.
issues.zh: add_members 迴圈逐筆寫入沒有 transaction，批次中一筆失敗時前面已寫入的成員不會回滾，群組落在沒人設計過的中間狀態。

issues.text: The public /groups/:name/members.json endpoint passes an unvalidated limit parameter straight into SQL with no upper bound, and since it's anonymously reachable and trust_level_0 includes every user on the site, any anonymous visitor can dump the entire site's username/name/avatar/last_seen list in one request (also enabling large-result-set DoS).
issues.zh: 公開的 /groups/:name/members.json 直接把未驗證的 limit 餵進 SQL 沒有上界，匿名可達且 trust_level_0 包含全站使用者，等於開了一個一次撈完全站使用者名單的入口。

issues.text: The same endpoint's offset parameter has no lower-bound check, so a negative offset value causes PostgreSQL to raise an error, resulting in an unhandled 500.
issues.zh: offset 未經驗證，負數會讓 PostgreSQL 直接報錯，變成 500。

issues.text: remove_member bypasses the Group model and calls group.users.delete directly, skipping the cleanup that used to null out primary_group_id, so a removed member's posts continue to display flair for a group they no longer belong to.
issues.zh: remove_member 繞過 model，被移除的成員仍保留該群組為 primary_group，貼文繼續掛著已不屬於的群組 flair。

issues.text: totalPages is computed with Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which produces an extra, entirely blank page whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size.
issues.zh: totalPages 用 floor + 1，成員數剛好是 limit 整數倍時會多出一頁空白。

issues.text: The public group members page is now silently truncated to 50 entries (previously unlimited for non-automatic groups) with no pagination UI at all, so visitors have no way to see or even know about members beyond the first 50.
issues.zh: 公開群組頁的成員清單被截到 50 筆，但那個畫面沒有任何分頁 UI。

issues.text: A pending pagination test that is exactly what this MR is supposed to fix was never enabled, and its assertions still assume the old array response shape rather than the new {members, meta} format.
issues.zh: pending 的分頁測試正是這個 MR 在修的東西，卻沒有被啟用，而且它的斷言假設的是舊的 array 格式。

issues.text: There is no test coverage at all for the new response format's meta.total/limit/offset fields that the frontend depends on.
issues.zh: 新的回應格式完全沒有測試，沒有斷言 meta.total / meta.limit / meta.offset 的值。

issues.text: A previously-existing test coverage for 'silently skip adding non-existent usernames' was removed with no equivalent replacement, even though that behavior is preserved in the new code.
issues.zh: 被刪掉的舊測試覆蓋（不存在的 username 會被安靜略過）沒有等價替代。

issues.text: One remove_member spec test uses the wrong HTTP verb (PUT instead of the routed DELETE), and since controller specs don't validate the verb against routes, it passes while documenting an incorrect API contract.
issues.zh: remove_member 的一個測試用 xhr :put 而路由註冊的是 delete，controller spec 的路徑產生不校驗動詞，記錄下錯誤的 API 契約。

issues.text: PUT is used for the non-idempotent add-members action, violating PUT's replace-the-resource semantics; the same request body sent twice produces different results (success, then a 500 from F-001).
issues.zh: PUT 用在非冪等的新增操作，重送同一份 body 結果不同，違反 PUT 的語意契約。

issues.text: The public members.json response format was changed in place from a plain array to an object (breaking change) with no expand/migrate/contract path, risking breakage for any third-party script or integration already consuming the old shape.
issues.zh: 公開 endpoint 的回應格式直接置換而非並存，可能讓 repo 外既有的讀者（第三方腳本、整合服務）壞掉。

issues.text: Several unrelated pure-formatting changes (ilike to ILIKE plus blank line, indentation of private/protected sections, a full reorder of an .hbs file, blank-line removal in another .hbs) are mixed into this behavioral commit, making the diff hard to review.
issues.zh: 與本議題無關的排版改動混進同一個 commit，讓 diff 難以逐行對照真正的行為變更。

issues.text: findMembers now returns undefined on its early-return path instead of a resolved promise like before, making its return type inconsistent between code paths even though no current caller chains .then on it yet.
issues.zh: findMembers 早退不再回傳 promise（回傳 undefined），與正常路徑回傳 promise 不一致。

issues.text: Two lines have misleading semicolon placement (a lone semicolon after a block that looks like part of the return statement, and a missing semicolon relying on ASI) that make the reader stop to double-check.
issues.zh: destroy 的 `{ return };` 落在 block 後面像是空語句，addMembers 缺分號靠 ASI 補，都是讀者要停下來確認的寫法。

issues.text: A '// TODO: should clear the input' comment shipped as-is, meaning the username input isn't cleared after a successful add, which is the direct trigger for the duplicate-add 500 (F-001) since users naturally click Add again.
issues.zh: // TODO: should clear the input 隨程式碼上線，使用者按第二次 Add 會重送同一批人，是 F-001 那條 500 路徑最容易被踩到的方式。

issues.text: findMembers was changed to a fire-and-forget call in setupController with the returned promise discarded, so the loading and error states that the previous afterModel-based implementation provided (via Ember's loading/error routes) are now gone; a failed request just leaves the UI permanently blank with no indication of what happened.
issues.zh: findMembers 改成 setupController 內的 fire-and-forget，載入中與失敗狀態都消失了，請求失敗時畫面永遠停在空清單。

open_questions.text: After group.users.delete(user_id), is the groups.user_count counter cache still accurate, given Rails' has_many :through #delete may not trigger the destroy callbacks that maintain the counter?
open_questions.zh: group.users.delete(user_id) 之後，groups.user_count 這個 counter cache 還準嗎？

open_questions.text: Does moving a block of shared form-styling CSS rules under .groups, .badges risk breaking styling on other pages that also relied on the original shared container?
open_questions.zh: .groups, .badges { .form-horizontal { ... } } 這段搬家，會不會讓 badges 以外的頁面掉樣式？
